title: 第368章 温柔体贴的齐瀚第367章 求和信
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
翌日，天刚蒙蒙亮，大家收拾好行装，准备妥当之后，就开始出发了。
因为齐煜的身上带着伤，所以回去的路途他不适合骑马，只能够躺在马车里。
而樱落腾出了马车的位置，和太子齐瀚同乘着一匹马。
这一路上，齐瀚对樱落颇为照顾着。
他总是给她讲述着皇宫里的趣事，讲述着一些樱落不知道的事情。
一直以来，齐瀚对于樱落来说，是有距离存在的。
这种距离让她幻想着，自己所喜欢的这个男人，不是世间普通男子。
也许他压根就不懂得什么是爱，也不懂得什么是亲近。
可是如今，太子殿下对她这般好，好到会事无巨细的顺应着自己。
樱落突然间，替以前的自己有些委屈鸣不平了。
其实并不是原本的太子不懂得爱，不懂得什么是亲近。
他懂，只是因为他不愿意为自己展现这些。
说到底，当时他心里的那个人并不是自己，而是太子妃张碧溪。
眼下，自己终于走进了齐瀚的心里，他也是会全心全意对待她的。
甚至齐瀚所能做到的，比自己在想象中想象的还要体贴，还要温柔。
樱落突然间觉得，自己能够等到他的温柔，好像这一切都显得值了。
“樱儿，你累不累？要不要停下来休息一会儿？”
“樱儿，你渴不渴？要不要喝口水？”
“樱儿，你……”
听着马车外面不断传来的温柔体贴声，齐煜苦涩一笑。

自从他们两个人回来之后，太子对樱落的态度，可以说是发生了一百八十度的大转弯。
从前的齐瀚，是断然不会说出如此有违本心的话的。
可是如今，齐瀚不但说出了这些话，还当着所有人的面，毫无违和的说出了这些话。
这就意味着，以前齐煜接近樱落就没有机会。
从今往后，他再也没有丝毫的机会了。
齐煜闭上了眼睛，不想再聆听着外面二人的动静。
只是齐瀚和樱落之间时不时传来的娇笑声，倒是愈发清晰了。
终于，在忍了一路之后，齐煜再也忍不住了。
他想，要是自己再不出言阻止他们两个人的话，迟早他会被他们给酸死的！
他敲了敲车窗，朝外面的人招了招手。
“让马车停下来！”
“吁”的一声，前面的冷凌有些莫名奇妙的勒住了马。
樱落也觉得奇怪，停住了笑意，和齐瀚下马走到齐煜的身前。
“怎么了？”
齐煜对外嚷嚷着：“本王身上的伤口不太舒服，这马车跑得太急，想停下来休息休息。太子哥哥，你们先行吧。”
“可是，你一个人在马车里可以吗？”
齐瀚有些不太放心的问道。
若是他们连同大军都走了，只留下齐煜和马车在这里，会不会不太安全？
“没事的！我休息休息，很快就追上你们了。”
“那好吧！”
content_en:
The next day, it was just dawn, everyone packed up their luggage and started to set off when they were ready.
Because Qi Yu was injured, he was not suitable for riding a horse on the way back and could only lie down in the carriage.
Ying Luo vacated her seat in the carriage and rode the same horse as Prince Qi Han.
Along the way, Qi Han took great care of Yingluo.
He always told her interesting stories in the palace, and told her some things that Yingluo didn't know.
Qi Han has always been distant from Ying Luo.
This distance made her imagine that the man she liked was no ordinary man in the world.
Maybe he doesn't understand what love is at all, nor what intimacy is.
But now, His Highness the Crown Prince is so kind to her, so good that he will comply with her in every detail.
Yingluo suddenly felt a little aggrieved for her former self.
In fact, it's not that the original prince didn't understand love or what intimacy was.
He understands, just because he doesn't want to show it to himself.
After all, the person in his heart at that time was not himself, but the Crown Princess Zhang Bixi.
Now, she has finally entered Qi Han's heart, and he will treat her wholeheartedly.
What Qi Han could do was even more considerate and gentle than he had imagined.
Yingluo suddenly felt that she could wait for his tenderness, and it seemed that everything was worth it.
"Ying'er, are you tired? Do you want to stop and rest for a while?"
"Ying'er, are you thirsty? Do you want a drink of water?"
"Ying'er, you..."
Listening to the gentle and considerate sounds coming from outside the carriage, Qi Yu smiled bitterly.
Since the two of them came back, the prince's attitude towards Ying Luo could be said to have undergone a 180-degree turn.
In the past, Qi Han would never have said anything that went against his true intentions.
But now, Qi Han not only said these words, but also said them in front of everyone without any violation.
This means that Qi Yu had no chance to get close to Yingluo before.
From now on, he will never have the slightest chance.
Qi Yu closed his eyes, not wanting to listen to the movements of the two people outside.
But the delicate laughter that came from time to time between Qi Han and Ying Luo became more and more clear.
Finally, after enduring it all the way, Qi Yu couldn't bear it anymore.
He thought that if he didn't say anything to stop the two of them, sooner or later he would be killed by them!
He knocked on the car window and waved to the people outside.
"Stop the carriage!"
With a "hush" sound, Leng Ling in front of him reined in his horse inexplicably.
Yingluo also felt strange, stopped smiling, and dismounted with Qi Han and walked to Qi Yu.
"What's wrong?"
Qi Yu shouted to the outside world: "The wound on my body is not very comfortable. The carriage is running too fast and I want to stop and rest. Brother Prince, you go first."
"But, is it okay for you to be alone in the carriage?"
Qi Han asked a little uneasy.
If they leave together with the army and only Qi Yu and the carriage are left here, will it be unsafe?
"It's okay! I'll take a rest and I'll catch up with you soon."
"Okay then!"
